plantedBugs.description: No auth check — any user can list all candidates across all orgs. Missing org_id filter and Clerk JWT verification.
No max limit — client can request limit=999999, effectively loading entire table. Should cap at 100.

Cursor is parsed as integer but used as string in WHERE id > ?1 — SQLite string comparison on UUIDs produces lexicographic ordering, which is not guaranteed to match creation order. Should use created_at + id composite cursor.
SELECT * returns all columns including sensitive data. Should explicitly select only needed fields.
